name: Nishi Masahito
source:
A scientist who researches insects. He lives in a big mansion on the outskirts of the city together with his assistant and maid, [url=/c56447]Yulia[/url].

He’s extremely well-mannered and curious. While he may appear kind, he's not above conducting "inhumane" experiments if it's for the sake of his research or to satisfy his curiosity.

He also gives [url=/c56450]Rengo[/url] many dangerous jobs, but Rengo doesn't mind, since they're both just using each other.

[Based on the [url=https://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/extra/cha/extra_cha_01_3_1.htm]official description[/url]]
